title: Read unit references in text
responsibility: Recognizes unit-reference markers while preserving all surrounding and malformed text.

inputs.name: isUnitId.value
inputs.description: The identity to check for lower-case dotted segments, each starting with a letter and otherwise containing letters, digits or hyphens, with at least two segments and at most 200 characters.

inputs.name: entityReferences.value
inputs.description: The text to divide into plain-text pieces and complete [[unit:identity]] markers. Invalid or unfinished markers remain ordinary text.

outputs.name: isUnitId
outputs.description: True when the identity matches the reference grammar; it does not check whether that unit is actually registered.

outputs.name: entityReferences
outputs.description: Ordered text and reference pieces whose text joins back to the original exactly. Reference pieces include the parsed identity and original marker. Empty input produces an empty list.
